sets.title: Two disjoint clusters: invoice_totals + access_guard, adjacent in file pair (1-line gap)
sets.description: K-30 probe: Two DIFFERENT small clone clusters (20-line invoice_totals + 15-line access_guard) placed back-to-back with 1-line separation in the same file pair. Tests whether tools merge adjacent matches (report 1 fat region) or preserve cluster identity (report 2). Cluster A: invoice_totals seed. Cluster B: access_guard seed. The 1-line gap between clones in each file simulates the 'separation tolerance' scenario - tools with loose gap tolerance may merge them.
sets.notes: K-30: 001/002. Two disjoint clusters (A=invoice_totals~20l, B=access_guard~15l) in same file pair, 1-line gap. Tests separation tolerance / cluster identity preservation. Tools that merge adjacent matches report 1 fat region (multi_cluster_reporting FAIL); tools with proper cluster identity report 2 clusters.

duplication.spacing_notes: 1-line separation between Cluster A and Cluster B in each carrier file. Cluster A members first, then 1-line gap, then Cluster B members.

capability_probe.pass_criterion: Tool reports exactly 2 clusters (one for invoice_totals, one for access_guard) instead of 1 merged region
capability_probe.fail_meaning: multi_cluster_reporting ABSENT - tool merged the two adjacent clusters into 1 fat region; lacks cluster identity preservation for nearby clones
